description_zh: 击毁第一个来袭目标。
description_en: Destroy your first incoming target.

description_zh: 在一场战役中累计击毁 1000 个目标。
description_en: Destroy 1,000 targets in one campaign.

description_zh: 购买第一次防线升级。
description_en: Purchase your first defense upgrade.

description_zh: 购买自动防御。
description_en: Purchase automated defense.

description_zh: 首次将天体转化为防御武器。
description_en: Convert a celestial body into a defense weapon.

description_zh: 首次释放已充能的大招。
description_en: Fire your first charged ultimate ability.

description_zh: 完成城市防线，进入地球阶段。
description_en: Complete the city defense and reach Earth.

description_zh: 完成地球防线，进入内太阳系阶段。
description_en: Complete the Earth defense and reach the inner Solar System.

description_zh: 完成内太阳系防线，进入外太阳系阶段。
description_en: Complete the inner Solar System defense and reach the outer Solar System.

description_zh: 完成外太阳系防线，进入奥尔特云阶段。
description_en: Complete the outer Solar System defense and reach the Oort Cloud.

description_zh: 完成奥尔特云防线，进入恒星邻域阶段。
description_en: Complete the Oort Cloud defense and reach the Stellar Neighbourhood.

description_zh: 完成恒星邻域防线，进入银河阶段。
description_en: Complete the Stellar Neighbourhood defense and reach the Milky Way.

description_zh: 完成银河防线，进入超星系团阶段。
description_en: Complete the Milky Way defense and reach the Supercluster.

description_zh: 完成超星系团防线，进入可观测宇宙阶段。
description_en: Complete the Supercluster defense and reach the Observable Universe.

description_zh: 完成可观测宇宙防线，进入宇宙膜阶段。
description_en: Complete the Observable Universe defense and reach the Brane.

description_zh: 守住全部十道防线，直到宇宙之外。
description_en: Hold all ten lines of defense, beyond the universe itself.

description_zh: 在一场战役中累计击毁 100 个目标。
description_en: Destroy 100 targets in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中累计击毁 10000 个目标。
description_en: Destroy 10,000 targets in one campaign.

description_zh: 将弹头伤害升级至 Lv.10。
description_en: Upgrade warhead damage to level 10.

description_zh: 将弹头伤害升级至 Lv.50。
description_en: Upgrade warhead damage to level 50.

description_zh: 在一场战役中部署至少 12 座炮台。
description_en: Deploy at least 12 turrets in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中部署全部 48 座炮台。
description_en: Deploy all 48 turrets in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中拥有全部十种主武器。
description_en: Own all ten main weapons in one campaign.

description_zh: 改造城市阶段的全部三座建筑。
description_en: Convert all three city buildings in one campaign.

description_zh: 将月球改造为月轨主炮。
description_en: Convert the Moon into its orbital cannon.

description_zh: 将太阳改造为戴森球武器。
description_en: Convert the Sun into a Dyson weapon.

description_zh: 将银心黑洞改造为黑洞引擎。
description_en: Convert the galactic central black hole into an engine.

description_zh: 在一场战役中改造超星系团阶段的全部六个天体。
description_en: Convert all six bodies of the Supercluster stage in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中改造可观测宇宙阶段的全部六个天体。
description_en: Convert all six bodies of the Observable Universe stage in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中改造宇宙膜阶段的全部六个卷曲维度。
description_en: Convert all six curled dimensions of the Brane stage in one campaign.

description_zh: 在一场战役中改造全部十个阶段的 50 个可改造天体。
description_en: Convert all 50 bodies across the ten stages in one campaign.

description_zh: 实际释放一次核弹大招。
description_en: Fire the nuclear ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次光粒打击。
description_en: Fire the photoid ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次一向箔。
description_en: Fire the dimensional foil ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次质数打击。
description_en: Fire the prime-number ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次降低光速大招。
description_en: Fire the light-speed reduction ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次改写 π 大招。
description_en: Fire the pi-rewriting ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次水滴大招。
description_en: Fire the Droplet ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次傅里叶分解大招。
description_en: Fire the Fourier Decomposition ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次曼德博分形大招。
description_en: Fire the Mandelbrot ultimate.

description_zh: 实际释放一次维度震荡大招。
description_en: Fire the Dimensional Resonance ultimate.

description_zh: 累计实际释放全部十种大招，可跨战役完成。
description_en: Fire all ten ultimates at least once, across any campaigns.

description_zh: 在蓄力期间打断一次可打断的 Boss 技能。
description_en: Interrupt a breakable boss skill during its wind-up.

description_zh: 在蓄力期间打断攻城主炮。
description_en: Interrupt the siege beam during its wind-up.

description_zh: 在蓄力期间打断吞噬。
description_en: Interrupt devour during its wind-up.
